text: 7月23日，沪深两市全天成交额合计21953.01亿元。其中，沪市成交额为10258.76亿元；深市成交额为11694.26亿元；创业板成交额为5187.41亿元。
text_en: On July 23, the total turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets was 2,195.301 billion yuan. Among them, the turnover of the Shanghai market was 1,025.876 billion yuan; the Shenzhen market turnover was 1,169.426 billion yuan; and the ChiNext market turnover was 518.741 billion yuan.
